title: purchase (native to page)
description: Outcome of the purchase sheet. The native app never acknowledges the purchase: the server does after verifying it.

result.description: purchased: Purchase.PurchaseState.PURCHASED, or a verified StoreKit transaction. pending: PurchaseState.PENDING (e.g. cash payment), or a StoreKit purchase waiting for approval (Ask to Buy), which has no purchaseToken yet. canceled: USER_CANCELED. already_owned: ITEM_ALREADY_OWNED, or a current App Store entitlement. unavailable: BILLING_UNAVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED. error: anything else.

productId.description: Google Play product id (subscription id), or App Store product identifier.

purchaseToken.description: Purchase.getPurchaseToken(), or the signed StoreKit transaction (VerificationResult.jwsRepresentation).

message.description: Developer-facing detail, never shown to the customer.
